status: source-only duplicate-resolution policy frozen before choosing a canonical row, opening any kinematic target, or selecting a final holdout galaxy
purpose: Resolve the 119 repeated Hydra team-release rows in the V19BU source-only candidate universe with an outcome-blind archive-quality rule, while retaining the raw alternatives and measuring sensitivity to four prespecified priority reorderings.

published_flag_semantics.boundary: The flags describe archive source/target availability and quality. They do not contain a rotation speed or any Sigma, MOND or halo outcome.

priority: qflag ascending, so an unflagged source beats a partially flagged source
kflag success rank 2 then 1 then 0, so an available successful public kinematic product beats a failed or absent product without reading it
catalogue_id ascending followed by the archive primary id ascending as deterministic final tie-breaks

claim_boundary: V19BV chooses one source-catalog row per WALLABY name; it does not choose the final galaxy holdout.
A successful public kinematic-product flag establishes target availability only and does not reveal or score the target value.
The 119 discarded canonical alternatives remain intact in the hash-bound V19BU raw CSV and can be propagated as a source systematic.

Only 27 duplicate names are invariant across all five prespecified priority orders; the 92 policy-sensitive names must carry both release rows as a source-reconstruction systematic rather than being called uniquely resolved.
No rotation curve, velocity field, fitted inclination, kinematic angle, gravity residual, halo result, action, universal constant or Solar-System optimization enters this transformation.
